## Description

Sell cash-secured puts; if assigned, hold the shares and sell covered calls until called away.

## Where it may fit

Liquid single names or ETFs with acceptable ownership risk and sideways/moderately rising price behavior.

## Vehicles

Self-directed option overlays; some income-oriented portfolios.

## Required data

Underlying prices, option chain/Greeks, strikes/expirations, cash and margin, dividends, assignment and fees.

## Caveats

Can concentrate exposure in falling assets; rolling changes the risk profile and does not guarantee recovery.
